name: Epoch AI Benchmarking Hub
about: Epoch AI runs and collects AI benchmark results. We keep its own SWE-bench Verified and MirrorCode results, and only scores and costs for results it collected from other projects.
attribution: Epoch AI, 'Capabilities & benchmarking'. Published online at epoch.ai. Retrieved from https://epoch.ai/benchmarks. Results collected from other projects keep their original terms, and we quote only top scores from those.
limitations: Benchmarks only cover the tasks they include, and models can be tuned for them.
Each model is dated by its release, not when it was tested, and not every model is tested on every benchmark.
